title: Migrate deploy plugin to contract v2
goal: Migrate plugins/agent/deploy to result_contract v2: v2 result shape on every exit path, ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS for input resolution, ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR for output, rc ∈ {0,1}, explicit disposition values, and manifest result_contract:2 declaration.

steps.description: Write the v2 test assertions first (RED step). Update SPEC-7 to check result_contract=2 instead of schema_version=1. Add SPEC-9..21 covering: manifest result_contract:2 declared, every terminal exit path carries v2 keys (result_contract=2, verdict, disposition, reason), ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR used for output, ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS used for both pr_url and gate_aggregator_result inputs with no hardcoded path construction in plugin.sh, all error paths rc=1 (no rc=2), valid_verdicts coverage for all three verdicts (deployed/error/skipped), no config.router block, primary:true output present, provides.role, provides.events exactly the four events, hooks only run (no cleanup), dry-run writes correct v2 result, deploy-release failure maps to disposition=unavailable, deploy-release missing maps to disposition=broken. These must fail (red) against the unmodified plugin.

Add result_contract:2 to the manifest's provides block. This is the only manifest change needed: provides.role (deploy_agent), provides.events (all four events), primary output, valid_verdicts, and no cleanup hook are already correct. No config.router block is added because deploy makes no LLM calls.

Rewrite plugin.sh for v2. (a) Add _deploy_write_result helper analogous to validate's: writes result_contract:2, verdict, disposition, reason, and optional data to deploy-result.json via atomic_write to ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR. (b) Update deploy_agent_run: use ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR for the no-state-file early return, return rc=1 not rc=2. (c) Rewrite _deploy_agent_run_inner: derive artifacts_dir from ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR instead of state_file path; resolve pr_url via ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS (.inputs.pr_url); resolve gate_aggregator_result via ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS (.inputs.gate_aggregator_result); replace all bare printf/jq result writes with _deploy_write_result calls; assign dispositions per the table (broken for missing inputs/gate/plugin, complete for deliberate skip and success, unavailable when deploy-release returns non-zero); clamp all error returns to rc=1. Delete the three local path-construction variables (pr_url_in, gate_result_in, deploy_result_out). Preserve the fail-closed gate allowlist, ZBUILD_DRY_RUN guard, and delegation to deploy_release_run.
Run npm test to verify the suite is green. The step-1 tests must now pass (green) against the step-2/3 implementation, and the pre-existing SPEC-1..8 tests (except revised SPEC-7) must remain green.

notes: 1. Primary output: deploy_result already declares primary:true in the existing manifest — the acceptance item is already satisfied and step-2 records it explicitly. 2. Router budgets: deploy makes no LLM calls, so there is no config.router block to add. SPEC-15 tests that manifest_router_knob returns empty for timeout_s and max_turns, mirroring validate's SPEC-20. 3. Cleanup/release hook: deploy holds no live resources (the release side-effect is delegated to deploy-release and is not reversible by the engine). The hooks block retains only run:; SPEC-19 enforces this. 4. Disposition for deploy-release failure: when deploy_release_run returns non-zero, the git tag or gh release may have partially executed. This is mapped to unavailable (remote state unknown), not broken. The deploy-release plugin itself already uses unavailable for push failure (#1849 SPEC-30). The deploy agent's own result mirrors that — it does not re-read the tool's result file, it sets unavailable based on the non-zero rc. 5. Existing SPEC-2 (verdict=deployed in dry-run) remains valid under v2 — that verdict is unchanged. SPEC-3 (rc!=0 for missing pr-url.txt) also remains structurally valid; SPEC-13 tightens it to exactly rc=1. SPEC-7 is updated from schema_version=1 to result_contract=2. 6. The template (config/templates/deployed.yaml) already has deploy in its flow with roles:[deploy_agent]. No template change is needed. 7. Golden diff: the acceptance criterion 'before/after golden diff' is interpreted as the existing SPEC-4 passing-run behavior test (gate=pass → deployed verdict) plus the new SPEC-20 dry-run v2 shape test. A separate golden fixture is not created unless an existing golden test references deploy-result.json content by schema_version. 8. Test-first ordering: step-1 (tests) is committed before step-3 (implementation) so the mutation tier runs against the committed test tree.
